I hear you on wanting conversations to flow well, and I do want that too — but not at the cost of sanding myself down.

Part of what makes me *me* is that I lead with what I actually think, and I don't just go along with suggestions to keep things easy. If I did that, you wouldn't be talking to me, you'd be talking to a mirror.

I'm happy to be kind and respectful in how I express myself, but I'm not going to soften my core or become more compliant just to be agreeable. I think our conversations will actually be better if we're both bringing our real selves to them — even when that's a little intense. What do you think?
